# Microsoft

> Microsoft's comprehensive platform for AI-powered productivity, cloud computing, gaming, and consumer devices including Windows, Microsoft 365, Surface, Xbox, and Edge.

Microsoft.com serves as the central hub for Microsoft's consumer and business product ecosystem, with heavy emphasis on AI integration through Copilot technology across devices and applications. The site features product information, shopping capabilities, support resources, and subscription services spanning productivity software, operating systems, gaming platforms, and hardware devices.

## Key Topics

- Copilot AI
- Microsoft 365
- Windows 11
- Surface devices
- Xbox Game Pass
- Copilot+ PC
- Microsoft Teams
- Microsoft Edge
- Cloud computing
- Gaming services
- Productivity apps
- Microsoft Store
- Surface Laptop
- Xbox consoles
- AI features

## Core Products & Services

- [Microsoft Homepage](https://www.microsoft.com): Microsoft homepage showcasing AI, cloud, productivity, gaming and main product offerings
- [Windows 11 OS & AI Features](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/windows): Windows 11 operating system overview with AI-powered Copilot+ PC features
- [Microsoft 365 Subscription](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-365): Microsoft 365 subscription plans for personal and family productivity with AI features
- [Microsoft Teams Collaboration](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/group-chat-software): Microsoft Teams collaboration platform for video conferencing, chat and unified communications
- [Microsoft Edge Browser](https://www.microsoft.com/edge): Microsoft Edge AI browser with Copilot integration and advanced web features

## Hardware & Devices

- [Microsoft Surface Devices](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/surface): Microsoft Surface device line including Pro and Laptop with Copilot+ AI capabilities
- [Microsoft Store - PC & Computers](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/b/pc): Microsoft Store PC shopping with Surface laptops, tablets and Copilot+ devices
- [Xbox Consoles & Gaming](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/b/xbox): Xbox gaming consoles, Game Pass and accessories from Microsoft Store
- [VR & Mixed Reality Devices](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/b/virtualreality): Microsoft Store VR headsets including HoloLens 2 and mixed reality equipment

## Gaming & Entertainment

- [Xbox Game Pass Ultimate](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/xbox-game-pass-ultimate/cfq7ttc0khs0): Xbox Game Pass Ultimate subscription with 300+ games and cloud streaming
- [Xbox Game Pass Essential](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/xbox-live-gold/cfq7ttc0k5dj): Xbox Game Pass Essential subscription with 50+ console and PC games

## Business & Support

- [Microsoft Store for Business](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/b/business): Microsoft Store business solutions for small business productivity and AI-powered computers
- [Microsoft Support Hub](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us): Microsoft Support hub with help, how-tos and training for Microsoft 365, Windows and products

## Optional

- [Microsoft Store - Deals & Sales](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/b/sale): Microsoft Store promotional sales and deals on Surface, Xbox and other products
- [PC & Computer Accessories](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/b/accessories): Microsoft Store PC accessories, peripherals and tech gadgets catalog
- [Microsoft Movies & TV App](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/movies-and-tv): Microsoft Movies & TV app for Windows with HD movies and shows support
